name: js-life
description: Conway's Game of Life — interactive cellular automaton simulator

scripts.build: npm run lint:quiet && babel script.js --source-maps -o script.compiled.js
scripts.lint: eslint script.js hashlife.js patterns.js canvas-renderer.js simulation.js
scripts.lint:quiet: eslint script.js hashlife.js patterns.js canvas-renderer.js simulation.js --quiet
